questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about Trichomonas vaginalis?

options.label: B
options.text: Twitching motility is seen on wet saline mount

options.label: C
options.text: Cysts are seen on wet saline mount of vaginal secretions

options.label: D
options.text: It is not a sexually transmitted infection

questions.answerText: Twitching motility is seen on wet saline mount
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B. Twitching motility is seen on wet saline mount

questions.stem: A lady from West Rajasthan presented with an ulcer surrounded by erythema on the right leg. Microscopy of the biopsy from the edge of the ulcer showed organisms with dark staining nuclei and kinetoplast. What is the most likely causative agent?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. Leishmania tropica

questions.stem: A child presents with a fever and a rash. Urine examination showed cells with owl's eye appearance. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. Cytomegalovirus

questions.stem: Infection with Clonorchis sinensis is associated with an increased risk of?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B. Cholangiocarcinoma

questions.stem: A boy presented with a fever and chills. Rapid test was positive for specific antigen HRP-2. Which of the following species of Plasmodium is the most likely causative agent?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. A.  Plasmodium falciparum

questions.stem: A child was brought with complaints of high fever, multiple seizures, headache, and neck rigidity. CS analysis showed low glucose, high protein, and many polymorphs. The CSF culture showed pleomorphic gram-negative bacilli. What is true about the causative organism?

options.label: B
options.text: Produces non-lactose fermenting colonies on MacConkey agar

options.label: C
options.text: Exhibits satellitism around Staphylococcus aureus colonies

options.label: D
options.text: It exhibits alpha hemolysis on sheep blood agar

questions.answerText: Exhibits satellitism around Staphylococcus aureus colonies
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C. Exhibits satellitism around Staphylococcus aureus colonies

questions.stem: A patient presented with a high fever, altered sensorium, headache, neck rigidity, and seizures. He was diagnosed with HSV encephalitis. Which of the following tests can be used to confirm the diagnosis?

options.label: D
options.text: CSF culture on chick embryo lines

questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  CSF PCR for viral DNA

questions.stemHtml: A man presents with a history of dysuria and urethral discharge after having unprotected sexual intercourse. Gram-staining of the purulent discharge is seen in the following image. What is the treatment of choice for this infection?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  Ceftriaxone

questions.stem: A militant presents with rashes all over his body sparing the palms and soles. On examination, he was febrile and lice were noted. Which of the following is responsible for his condition?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  Rickettsia prowazekii

questions.stem: Microfilariae with sheathed tail and two nuclei at the tail tip is suggestive of?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  Brugia malayi

questions.stem: A female patient presents with complaints of thick white vaginal secretions. Which of the following can be used to identify the likely species of the causative agent?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  CHROMagar

questions.stem: A newly joined teacher develops rice water stools. The causative agent acts on which of the following receptors?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  GM1 ganglioside receptor

questions.stem: A woman with recurrent diarrhea is prescribed a broad-spectrum antibiotic. Which of the following is not true regarding Clostridium difficile infection?

options.label: A
options.text: Oral fidaxomicin is used for treatment

options.label: C
options.text: IgM assay is used to confirm the diagnosis

options.label: D
options.text: Pseudomembrane consists of leukocytes, fibrin, and cellular debris

questions.answerText: IgM assay is used to confirm the diagnosis
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  IgM assay is used to confirm the diagnosis
questions.stemHtml: A woman with recurrent diarrhea is prescribed a broad-spectrum antibiotic. Which of the following is not true regarding Clostridium difficile infection?

questions.stem: A patient from Uttar Pradesh presented with fever, pallor, and hepatosplenomegaly. Peripheral smear examination showed pancytopenia. Buffy coat examination showed macrophages laden with organisms with a kinetoplast. What is the vector for the likely disease?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  Sandfly

questions.stemHtml: A patient admitted with 50% burns develops an infection at the burn site. The swab was cultured, the isolate is a strict aerobe and the test that is shown in the image is positive. What is the likely etiology of the burn infection?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  Pseudomonas aeruginosa

questions.stemHtml: A 25-year-old male who engaged in unprotected sexual intercourse develops urethral discharge one week later as shown in the given image. What is the most likely causative organism for this condition?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  Neisseria gonorrhea

questions.stem: An unimmunized 2-year old child presented with coryza, conjunctivitis, and bluish-white spots in his buccal mucosa near the lower molar teeth. A day later, he developed a maculopapular rash on the face and neck. What is the nature of the causative virus?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  Enveloped ss RNA

questions.stem: A group of 20 friends kept partying till late at night. Two of them ate pastries from outside. They present with nausea and vomiting in the early morning. What is the most likely causative agent implicated?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  Enterotoxin of Staphylococcus

questions.stem: A 3-year old child presents with fever, loose stools, and blood in the stool. What is the enrichment medium used to isolate the organism from the stool sample?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  Selenite F broth

questions.stem: A patient was suspected to have acute brucellosis. A serum sample was sent for a standard agglutination test. It came out to be negative initially but after serial dilutions of the serum sample, the test turned out to be positive. Which of the following is responsible for the initial negative test?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  Prozone phenomenon
questions.stemHtml: A patient was suspected to have acute brucellosis. A serum sample was sent for a standard agglutination test. It came out to be negative initially but after serial dilutions of the serum sample, the test turned out to be positive. Which of the following is responsible for the initial negative test?

questions.stem: Which of the following immunoglobulins shows highest concentration in the serum?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. D Ig G

questions.stem: A patient is suffering from fever and he is diagnosed with condition caused by a lactose fermenting bacteria, he is advised for culture, Which culture media is used to differentiate lactose and non-lactose fermenter. ?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. Mac conkey agar

questions.stem: A Cattle farmer with a scab lesion in the arm. Microscopic examination shows brick/box shaped gram-positive organism with squared ends and spores in the centre. Most likely organism which is responsible for his condition is?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. Bacillus anthracis

questions.stemHtml: A truck driver is presenting with a painless ulcer with firm base, what is the next investigation you will prefer to do?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. Dark field microscopy for spirochetes

questions.stemHtml: A Patient is infected with a dimorphic fungus which involves the subcutaneous layers, identify the organism responsible for it?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C. Sporothrix

questions.stem: A child who is regularly eating outside is presenting with icterus and diarrhea, which of the following infectious agent can spread through the Feco-oral route?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. Hepatitis A

questions.stem: A patient present with multiple episodes or bloody diarrhea. On investigation of blood sample Enterohemorrhagic strain of E. Coli was isolated. On which of the following media this organism can be cultured?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. D. Sorbitol MacConkey agar

questions.stem: A patient presented with multiple asymptomatic scaly patches varying in color from white to tan to brown to pink. On potassium hydroxide wet mount spaghetti and meat ball appearance is seen. Which of the following is causative organism for this disease?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B. Malassezia furfur

questions.stem: A 30-year-old worker named John presents with swollen lymph nodes in his left armpit. He recently got bitten by fleas while working in a wheat godown. The affected area is red and tender. To investigate the cause, a smear from his axillary lymph node is examined. Which is the most suitable stain for this examination?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B. Giemsa

questions.stem: Gram positive alpha hemolytic cocci with catalase negative and optochin resistant causing endocarditis?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. D.  Streptococcus sanguis

questions.stem: Which can cause condyloma acuminata?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. D.  HPV 6,11

questions.stem: A child presented with complaint of dysphagia cough, and greyish white membrane over the tonsils. Which of the following is causative organism?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  C. diphtheria

questions.stem: Rh-ve mother had Rh+ve child. This Rh incompatibility is which type of hypersensitivity reaction?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  Cytotoxic

questions.stem: In the case of an elderly male presenting with meningitis, a gram stain of the CSF sample shows the presence of gram-positive bacilli. Which of the following statements accurately pertains to the motility of the responsible microorganism?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  Motile at 25° C, non-motile at 37°C

questions.stem: An elderly male patient who received a kidney transplant a decade ago is presently under immunosuppressive treatment. He reports experiencing a persistent cough and shortness of breath over the past week. Microscopic examination of his sputum reveals the presence of gram-positive budding yeast cells and pseudohyphae. What is the probable diagnosis in this case?

options.label: D
options.text: Information is not enough for the diagnosis

questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  Invasive candidiasis

questions.stem: Among the options provided, which protozoan parasite is found within Kupffer cells?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  Leishmania donovani

questions.stemHtml: Which of the following conditions is the causative agent associated with in this case?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  Pure red cell aplasia

questions.stem: A person arrived with a lesion on their left buttock. This individual has a past medical record of undergoing a heart transplant 15 years ago. Analysis of the fluid extracted from the lesion reveals the presence of gram-positive filamentous bacteria. What is the probable microbial agent responsible for this condition?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  Nocardia

questions.stemHtml: A person who has undergone a bone marrow transplant in the past is now presenting with a lung lesion. Upon microscopic analysis, the image of the lesion is provided below. What is the probable responsible organism for this condition?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. D.  Aspergillosis

questions.stemHtml: Identify the pathognomonic structure in the slide given below?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  Sclerotic body

questions.stemHtml: Which of the following viruses exhibits genetic re-assortment similar to that of influenza virus?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A.  1

questions.stem: Which of the following are acid-fast staining organisms? 1. Nocardia 2. Mycobacterium leprae 3. Actinomyces 4. Cryptosporidium parvum 5. Isospora belli
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B. 1, 2, 4, 5

questions.stem: A microbiologist stained a tissue sample and found thin, filamentous bacteria, which resembled Nocardia sp. What other staining technique should be done to confirm the presence of Nocardia?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. D. Modified acid-fast stain
questions.stemHtml: A microbiologist stained a tissue sample and found thin, filamentous bacteria, which resembled Nocardia sp. What other staining technique should be done to confirm the presence of Nocardia?

questions.stem: Which pathogen causes attachment-effacement lesion in the intestinal mucosa?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B. Enteropathogenic Escherichia coli

questions.stemHtml: Identify the component responsible for endotoxic shock in gram-negative bacteria?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  1

questions.stemHtml: A 6-year-old boy complains of cough and throat pain. On examination of the oral cavity, a white pseudo membrane was visualized. A swab was taken from it and stained as given in the image below. What is the procedure for the following staining? 1. Albert's stain- I 2. Acid alcohol 3. Gram's iodine 4. Safranin 5. Methylene blue 6. Crystal violet 7. Carbol fuschin 8. Acetone
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  6, 3, 8, 4

questions.stem: A 24-year-old male patient presented to the outpatient department with cervical lymphadenopathy. As a part of the evaluation, the Paul-Bunnell test was done. What is the principle of this test?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. C.  Heterophile antibodies

questions.stemHtml: A man presents with the following lesion after traumatic inoculation. Identify the causative organism?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  Sporothrix schencki

questions.stemHtml: A farmer presents with a swollen foot and multiple sinuses as shown in the below image. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. A. Mycetoma

questions.stem: Which among the following methods is used to sterilize a glass petri dish?

options.label: A
options.text: Autoclaving at 121 degrees Celsius for 30 - 60 minutes

options.label: B
options.text: Hot air oven at 160 degrees Celsius for 120 minutes or less

options.label: C
options.text: Flash autoclaving at 134 degrees Celsius for 3 minutes

options.label: D
options.text: Hot air oven at 121 degrees Celsius for 30 - 60 minutes

questions.answerText: Hot air oven at 160 degrees Celsius for 120 minutes or less
questions.solutionHtml: Ans. B.  Hot air oven at 160 degrees Celsius for 120 minutes or less
